snippet.title: Othercrown: Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Introducing Othercrown, a deckbuilding auto-battler roguelite where you play as the villain. Your army lives on your slot reels, and each card you draw becomes a symbol within your slot machine. Through it, you deploy spells and monsters during battles and work towards the craziest builds. Maximise the efficiency of your slots and deploy as many creatures and spells as you can during your fights against the human kingdoms. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: http://steampowered.com/app/5217270?utm_source=press-release-reveal
